x01_intro.speaker: neha
x01_intro.text: This is how Kairos works, under the hood.

t1_record.speaker: neha
t1_record.text: Every borrower lives in one record. Loans, payments, replies, consent. Money is kept to the paisa.

x02_churn.speaker: neha
x02_churn.text: Every day, and on every event, the churn engine re-sorts each borrower. Their cohort, their risk, their step in the journey, and the layer of contact. Pay, or say stop, and they leave the journey at once.

t2_model.speaker: neha
t2_model.text: A learning model scores every channel and every hour for them, using what worked for similar borrowers in their region, and for them personally.

t3_reserve.speaker: neha
t3_reserve.text: Before a message is queued, Aladdin reserves the budget and the contact limit. At the moment of sending, it checks the rules again.

t4_webhooks.speaker: neha
t4_webhooks.text: Messages go out through each channel's API. Delivery, read and reply receipts come back as webhooks. Duplicates are ignored.

x03_voice.speaker: neha
x03_voice.text: Voice calls run on Sarvam agents, in eight languages. Every call returns a disposition with a confidence score. Below the threshold, a person reviews it.

t5_intent.speaker: neha
t5_intent.text: Replies are understood by rules first, then a small model, then Sarvam's decision model. If it's still unsure, a human decides.

x04_cm03.speaker: neha
x04_cm03.text: Inbound WhatsApp runs on its own state machine. No account details before OTP. Payment claims are checked against the bank, so doctored screenshots and reused references are caught.

x05_hitl.speaker: neha
x05_hitl.text: And a person can take control at any moment. Pause a campaign, approve or reject a held call, put a borrower on hold, or take over a conversation. Every action goes through Aladdin, and into the audit log.

t6_loop.speaker: neha
t6_loop.text: Every outcome is written back, and the model updates. Same data in, same decision out. Every step, on the record.

x06_proof.speaker: neha
x06_proof.text: Fifty thousand decisions in about two minutes. Zero cap breaches. And forty-nine out of forty-nine red-team attacks, blocked.

x07_end.speaker: neha
x07_end.text: Kairos. Built to be trusted with every rupee, and every borrower.
